The Memphis Grizzlies (7-3) host the Denver Nuggets (5-4) in the Grizzlies' 11th game of the season. Memphis is 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, and 7th in the West, with a 7-3 record over its last ten games, a win in its most recent game, a 5-0 road record, and a 2-3 home record. Denver is 4th in the Northwest, 2.5 games back, and 10th in the West, with a loss in its most recent game, a 3-2 road record, and a 2-2 home record.

Memphis is without Quinten Post (head), Richie Saunders (knee, surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision. Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain).

The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Grizzlies lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 136-119 loss in Denver on April 8, 2026.
